what: Like a design tool screen — a cursor with a name tag enters from the bottom right of the title (+120·+160) to the top-left corner (−18·−3) in .8s power3.inOut, then drags to the bottom right (+18·+14) in .9s power2.inOut while a selection box (handles at all four corners) grows along with it. After .75s it measures the title size and shows a ‹width × height› label in 1.55s over .3s, and from 1.85s the cursor wanders inside the upper right of the title with 2.6s sine.inOut (picking a new spot on every round trip). fx:point { el, label } Hands off to point at another element (mail link), and returns with fx:release

options.label: Cursor label text, default Name
options.delay: Start delay (seconds), default 1.3 — the original waits while the title letter-spacing gathers
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Title to wrap (required). The box and size table go inside it, and the cursor is created inside the attached panel

use: Studio Name

from.where: index.html #heroInner name wordmark — original intro timeline (delay .25): cursor 1.05s .8 power3.inOut → 1.85s drag .9 power2.inOut, dimensions 2.6s .3, 2.9s idle 2.6 sine.inOut yoyo repeatRefresh, at the end hand off to the mail link .8 power3.inOut

note: Even when the plate is zoomed or moved, it divides by the plate scale and moves in plate coordinates. With reduced motion only the box is drawn and the cursor is hidden
